column1: # Fixed level-1 door encounter for the retail-vs-port telemetry fixture (issue #9).
# The pose is `shots.tsv`'s `route_door` row (level 1's upper-door `walkplayer` placement, thing
# 174). Both sides stand the player body there with no input, run for the same **game** time, and
# columns: name  level  x  y  z  pitch  yaw  frames  cadence_ms
# `x y z` are the camera eye, the same convention `shots.tsv` uses; the "port" half passes them to
# `--shot-at` and `--warp` (body one eye offset below), and the "retail" half warps the body the same
# way. `frames` is the port's fixed 1/60 s step, so 600 = 10.0 s; retail runs until its engine clock
